body:
**Summary**

When the Insights middleware receives a new `userToken`, it immediately applies it to the state. This causes an issue when dynamic widgets are initialized, because a new search will occur at the same time, but the second one won't be caught by the search client cache, due to the userToken now being part of the search request.

~~This PR detects when a rerender is expected, and in consequence delays the application of the userToken until the next tick, so that the search request can be returned from cache.~~

This PR always delays the application of an updated userToken until the next tick, if received after init, so that the search request can be returned from cache.

This doesn't apply to userToken retrieved from cookies, or set as initial insights param, as those are retrieved before init.

FX-2400
